title: Go and Rust mappers
goal: map runs GOTOOLCHAIN=local go list -e -json ./... and go mod edit -json for Go modules, and cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps --offline --locked for Cargo workspaces, turning their JSON into the map's packages and imports; fake go and cargo scripts in the tests prove the exact argument lists and environment.

gates.question: May kbingest.py map run go (go list, go mod edit) with exactly the argument list and environment in this task's goal, in a scratch worktree with a timeout? With GOTOOLCHAIN=local it must not download a toolchain.

May kbingest.py map run cargo (cargo metadata) with exactly the argument list and environment in this task's goal, in a scratch worktree with a timeout? Offline and locked; it must not build or run build scripts.
